description.en: The ID of the experiment to which the run belongs.
The time when the instance was created.

description.zh:
任务的标签，精确匹配。支持：
- 单标签查询："is_evaluation:true"
- 多标签场景（非特殊场景不推荐，可能存在性能问题）："is_evaluation:true,LLM_evaluation:true" 使用半角逗号（,）分隔，表示多个标签key-value需要同时匹配。
description.en:
The labels of the run for an exact match. The following formats are supported:

- Single-label query: "is\_evaluation:true"

- Multi-label query: "is\_evaluation:true,LLM\_evaluation:true". This method is not recommended for common scenarios because it may degrade performance. Use commas (,) to separate multiple labels. The system matches all specified key-value pairs.

description.zh: 请求的最大结果数，默认为10。
description.en: The maximum number of results to return. The default value is 10.

description.zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序，与SortBy结合使用。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC（默认值）：降序。
description.en:
The sort order for the paged query. Use this parameter with SortBy.

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC (default): descending order.

description.zh: 排序方式的字符串列表，支持排序的字段包括：GmtCreateTime、Name。排序方式包括DESC和ASC，默认为ASC。支持多个字段，用半角逗号","分隔。
description.en: The fields to sort by and the sort order. You can sort by GmtCreateTime and Name. Valid sort orders are DESC and ASC. The default is ASC. To sort by multiple fields, separate them with a comma (,).

description.zh: 当前页数。 取值范围：大于0。 默认值：1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1.
The number of records to display on each page.
The paging token. The value starts from 0. The default value is 0.

description.zh:
用于排序的字段名，取值如下：
- Name：Run名称。
- GmtCreateTime（默认值）：Run创建时间。
description.en:
The field to use for sorting. Valid values:

- Name: the name of the run.

- GmtCreateTime (default): the time when the run was created.
The ID of the PAI workload associated with the run.
The type of the PAI workload associated with the run.

description.zh:
是否展示详细信息，包括：Metrics、Params和Labels。取值如下：
- true：表示展示详细信息。
- false（默认值）：表示不展示详细信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to display details, including Metrics, Params, and Labels. Valid values:

- true: displays details.

- false (default): does not display details.

description.zh:
实验所在工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
> 不填写工作空间ID，系统将返回默认工作空间的运行列表。
>
description.en:
The ID of the workspace where the experiment resides. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).

> If you do not specify a workspace ID, the system returns the list of runs in the default workspace.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-runs --name myName --workspace-id 22800 --experiment-id exp-1zpfthdx000000 --source-type TrainingService --source-id job-rbvg5wzlj0000 --labels is_evaluation:true --verbose true --gmt-create-time 2021-01-30T12:51:33.028Z --order-by GmtCreateTime_DESC,Name_ASC --page-token 0 --max-results 10 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/runs --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy 'GmtCreateTime_DESC,Name_ASC' --Order DESC --Verbose true --PageSize 10 --SortBy GmtCreateTime --SourceType TrainingService --SourceId 'job-rbvg5wzlj0000' --MaxResults 10 --WorkspaceId 22800 --PageToken 0 --Labels 'is_evaluation:true' --Name myName --PageNumber 1 --ExperimentId 'exp-1zpfthdx000000' --GmtCreateTime '2021-01-30T12:51:33.028Z' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
